website.readmeExcerpt:
# Graphics Config
Allows you to save/load/share graphics setting presets (based on your System Configuration menu) at any time, including when triggered by events like entering a battle, cutscene, duty, gpose, and more. Also supports conditions like loading into a city or foray areas.
